title: Ready multiplication configuration
statement: Given Boolean lists $x,a,b,c$ and a function $v$ assigning a natural-number value to each position in $\\{0,1,\ldots,12\}$, the configuration is ready when $v(1)=|x|$, $v(2)=2|a|+2$, $v(3)=2|a|+2+2|b|+2$, $v(4)=2|a|$, $v(5)=2|a|+2+2|b|$, $v(6)=|a|+|b|$, and $v(7)=v(11)=v(12)=0$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $v$ from thirteen positions to the natural numbers
